title: SocialOmni: Benchmarking Audio-Visual Social Interactivity in Omni Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.16859v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating omni-modal large language models (OLMs) in multi-party dialogue requires more than answer correctness on pre-segmented inputs. We introduce SocialOmni, an offline diagnostic benchmark that separates three turn-level decisions: identifying who is speaking, deciding when a designated participant should enter at an annotated query time, and determining how that participant should continue the dialogue. SocialOmni contains 2,000 perception items and a quality-controlled core split of 200 interaction-generation items, including naturally occurring speaker-visibility mismatches. Each item is independently checked by three human annotators. Evaluated systems receive only query-time-bounded multimodal evidence, while manually verified reference continuations are reserved for response judging. translated_title: SocialOmni：面向全模态模型音视频社交互动能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: 评估全模态大语言模型（OLMs）在多方对话中的表现，不能仅仅依靠对预先分段输入的答案正确性。我们提出了SocialOmni，一个离线诊断基准，它将三个轮次级别的决策分离开来：识别谁在说话、决定指定参与者在标注的查询时刻应何时介入对话，以及确定该参与者应如何继续对话。SocialOmni包含2,000个感知条目和一个经过质量控制的200个交互生成条目的核心子集，其中包括自然出现的说话者可见性不匹配情况。每个条目均由三名人类标注员独立核查。被评估的系统仅接收以查询时刻为边界的多模态证据，而人工验证的参考续写则保留用于回答评判。一个完整的三评委集成系统对所有符合条件的回答进行评分，并进行了留一评委和家族敏感性审计。在11个全模态模型中，排名……
tldr: 提出了SocialOmni基准，通过将多方对话中“谁在说话、何时介入、如何续写”三个轮次级决策解耦，系统评估了全模态大语言模型的音视频社交互动能力。
en_tdlr: SocialOmni is an offline diagnostic benchmark that decouples who-speaks, when-to-enter, and how-to-continue turn-level decisions to systematically evaluate the audio-visual social interactivity of omni-modal large language models in multi-party dialogue.
